verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing is thoroughly documented as an API-driven product: creating paymentInstruments, managing card lifecycle, webhooks, transaction rules, and disputes are all done via REST-style API resources rather than UI-only flows, and docs.adyen.com/llms.txt confirms a machine-readable docs entry point. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe returned 404s) and no independent/hands-on confirmation of API usability outside vendor docs.
